'''Chokan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian sector]].

At some point [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited Chokan during his [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] career. [[Isolder]] also visited this place and remembered the local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] port authority code.
